m: Two characters that only live together, quick as a bright child: **clever**.
ex: 这个小女孩很伶俐。
This little girl is very bright.
她口齿伶俐，很会说话。
She's articulate and a good talker.
use: For children; 聪明伶俐 is a set phrase.

ex: 大家都哭了，他却无动于衷。
Everyone cried, but he was unmoved.
看到别人有困难，你怎么能无动于衷？
How can you stay indifferent when others are in trouble?

m: What is **always** done at **home**: **everyday family life**.
ex: 我们坐下来聊聊家常。
Let's sit down and have a chat.
妈妈做了几个家常菜。
Mum made a few home-style dishes.
use: 家常菜, home cooking; 拉家常, to chat.

ex: 指南针是中国人发明的。
The compass was invented by the Chinese.
没有指南针，我们在山里迷路了。
Without a compass, we got lost in the mountains.
这件衣服的款式很新。
The style of this piece of clothing is very new.
这种手机有三种款式。
This phone comes in three styles.
老人的表情很安详。
The old man's expression is serene.
她安详地睡着了。
She fell asleep peacefully.
use: For faces and manners; 安详地去世, to die peacefully.

ex: 他们之间有很多恩怨。
There's a lot of history between them.
过去的恩怨就算了吧。
Let's forget past grievances.
别耍把戏了。
Stop playing tricks.
我早就看穿了他的把戏。
I saw through his little game long ago.
他在街上发传单。
He's handing out leaflets in the street.
我在门口收到了一张传单。
I got a flyer at the door.
use: Measure word 张; 发传单, hand out flyers.

ex: 士兵向国旗敬礼。
The soldiers salute the flag.
学生们向老师敬礼。
The students saluted the teacher.
他整天发牢骚。
He grumbles all day long.
别发牢骚了，快干活吧。
Stop moaning and get to work.
use: Goes with 发: 发牢骚, to grumble.

ex: 演出结束，演员向观众鞠躬。
At the end of the show, the actors bowed to the audience.
他深深地鞠躬表示感谢。
He bowed deeply to show his thanks.
我的颈椎不好。
I have neck problems.
长时间看手机对颈椎不好。
Looking at your phone a long time is bad for your neck.
use: Common health complaint for office workers.

ex: 我很喜欢吃海鲜。
I really like seafood.
这家饭馆的海鲜很新鲜。
The seafood in this restaurant is very fresh.

m: **Turn** and **tell** others: **to pass on** a message.
ex: 请转告他明天开会。
Please tell him there's a meeting tomorrow.
我会把你的话转告给经理。
I'll pass your words on to the manager.
昨天下了冰雹。
It hailed yesterday.
冰雹把车窗砸坏了。
The hail smashed the car windows.
他走路有点吃力。
He walks with some difficulty.
这本书对我来说太吃力了。
This book is too hard going for me.
use: Spoken; 很吃力, quite a struggle.

ex: 妈妈总是唠叨。
Mum is always nagging.
别唠叨了，我知道了。
Stop nagging; I know.
前面路口向左拐弯。
Turn left at the next junction.
他说话喜欢拐弯抹角。
He likes to beat around the bush.
use: 拐弯抹角 means to talk in circles.

ex: 过年的时候，孩子们收到很多红包。
At New Year, children get lots of red envelopes.
老板给每个人发了红包。
The boss gave everyone a bonus.
use: Also digital red packets on phones.

m: A **horse** and a **tiger**, neither one nor the other: **careless**.
ex: 他做事很马虎。
He's sloppy in how he does things.
考试的时候不能马虎。
You can't be careless in exams.
他们一家人很和睦。
Their family gets along very well.
邻居之间要和睦相处。
Neighbours should live in harmony.

m: What you **hold** in your **hand** with ease: **good at**.
ex: 做饭是他的拿手本领。
Cooking is his forte.
这是我妈妈的拿手菜。
This is my mum's signature dish.
路边的松树很挺拔。
The pines by the road are tall and straight.
他的身材高大挺拔。
He is tall and upright.
他会变魔术。
He can do magic tricks.
孩子们最喜欢看魔术表演。
Children love watching magic shows.
use: 变魔术, to do magic tricks.

ex: 我想吃点清淡的。
I'd like something light.
医生让他饮食清淡一点。
The doctor told him to eat less rich food.
服务员，请给我菜单。
Waiter, the menu please.
这家店的菜单上有一百多个菜。
This restaurant's menu has more than a hundred dishes.
use: Measure word 份 or 张; also a computer menu.

ex: 我的记性不好。
I have a bad memory.
你看我这记性，又忘了带钥匙。
Look at my memory, I forgot my keys again.
向您表示诚挚的感谢。
We express our sincere thanks to you.
他们受到了诚挚的欢迎。
They received a warm welcome.
老虎身上有黑色的斑纹。
Tigers have black stripes.
这只猫的斑纹很特别。
This cat's markings are unusual.
编辑正在看稿件。
The editor is reading manuscripts.
请在周五前交稿件。
Please hand in your article before Friday.

m: Like a **net** of **continuous** threads that are **never** **cut**: **an endless stream**.
ex: 来参观的人络绎不绝。
Visitors keep coming in an endless stream.
节日期间，商店里顾客络绎不绝。
During the holiday, customers poured into the shops.
use: For streams of people or cars.

ex: 双方正在洽谈合作。
Both sides are discussing a partnership.
我们约了客户下午洽谈。
We've arranged to meet the client this afternoon to talk business.
明天我要论文答辩。
Tomorrow I have my thesis defence.
他在答辩时回答得很好。
He answered well at his defence.
我说话算数。
I keep my word.
这次不算数，再来一次。
This time doesn't count; let's do it again.
use: 说话算数, to mean what you say.

ex: 他是个很有才干的人。
He's a very capable person.
这份工作能让你发挥才干。
This job will let you use your abilities.
快叫救护车！
Call an ambulance quickly!
救护车很快就到了。
The ambulance arrived very quickly.

m: **One** **eye**'s glance and it is **clear**, **so**: **clear at a glance**.
ex: 这张图一目了然。
This chart is clear at a glance.
问题在哪里，大家一目了然。
Everyone could see right away where the problem was.
他的动作很笨拙。
His movements are clumsy.
小熊笨拙地爬上了树。
The little bear clumsily climbed the tree.
他恳切地请求我帮忙。
He earnestly asked me for help.
她的语气很恳切。
Her tone was sincere.
警察查获了一批毒品。
The police seized a batch of drugs.
海关查获了很多假货。
Customs seized a lot of counterfeit goods.
这只是空想。
This is just a pipe dream.
别空想了，开始行动吧。
Stop daydreaming and get going.

m: **Exhaust** to the **utmost** **all** your **power**: **to do one's utmost**.
ex: 我会竭尽全力帮助你。
I'll do everything I can to help you.
医生们竭尽全力救了他的命。
The doctors did their utmost and saved his life.
use: Formal; close to 全力以赴.

m: Put the **lid** of a **seal** on: **to stamp**.
ex: 这份文件需要盖章。
This document needs to be stamped.
请在这里盖章。
Please stamp here.
use: Official seals matter in Chinese paperwork.

ex: 我每天早上跑步。
I go running every morning.
跑步对身体很好。
Running is very good for you.
use: Split as 跑了一会儿步; 去跑步, go for a run.

ex: 国旗在空中飘扬。
The national flag flutters in the air.
她的长发在风中飘扬。
Her long hair streamed in the wind.

m: Feel in your **body** and **understand**: **to be understanding**.
ex: 请体谅一下我的难处。
Please be understanding about my difficulties.
妈妈很体谅我工作忙。
Mum is very understanding about how busy I am.
use: Close to 理解, but warmer.

ex: 他用刀恐吓别人。
He threatened people with a knife.
她收到了一封恐吓信。
She received a threatening letter.
他很关心时事。
He follows current affairs closely.
我们每周有一节时事课。
We have a current affairs class every week.
他的态度很暧昧。
His attitude is vague.
他们俩的关系有点暧昧。
There's something ambiguous going on between those two.

m: Love so much it **hurts**: **to dote on**.
ex: 奶奶非常疼爱我。
Grandma dotes on me.
父母都疼爱自己的孩子。
All parents love their children dearly.
小猫躲藏在床下。
The kitten is hiding under the bed.
他躲藏了好几年，最后还是被找到了。
He hid for several years, but was found in the end.
他们之间有隔阂。
There's a rift between them.
多沟通可以消除隔阂。
More communication can remove misunderstandings.
use: 消除隔阂, to bridge a gap.

ex: 我早饭吃了两个包子。
I had two steamed buns for breakfast.
这家店的肉包子特别好吃。
This shop's meat buns are especially tasty.
他虚心向别人学习。
He humbly learns from others.
我们要虚心接受批评。
We should accept criticism with an open mind.
use: Before verbs: 虚心学习, 虚心接受.

ex: 汽车引擎坏了。
The car's engine has broken down.
他打开了车的引擎盖。
He opened the car's bonnet.
use: Also 搜索引擎, search engine.

ex: 油炸食品不健康。
Fried food isn't healthy.
我不太爱吃油炸的东西。
I don't really like deep-fried things.
活该！谁让你不听话。
Serves you right! You wouldn't listen.
他被骗了，有人说他活该。
He was cheated, and some said he deserved it.
她的身材很苗条。
She has a slim figure.
为了苗条，她每天跑步。
To stay slim, she runs every day.
别讥笑别人的错误。
Don't sneer at other people's mistakes.
他受到了同学们的讥笑。
He was mocked by his classmates.
这种制度有很多弊病。
This system has many flaws.
我们要改正工作中的弊病。
We need to fix the problems in our work.
当心！车来了！
Look out! A car's coming!
下雨路滑，当心摔倒。
The road is slippery in the rain; mind you don't fall.

m: A contest **in advance** of the **competition**: **preliminary heats**.
ex: 他在预赛中表现很好。
He did very well in the heats.
只有前八名能通过预赛。
Only the top eight get through the preliminaries.
use: Then 半决赛 and 决赛.

ex: 树枝在风中摇摆。
The branches sway in the wind.
他的态度一直在摇摆。
His attitude keeps wavering.
今天我破例喝了一杯酒。
Today I made an exception and had a drink.
老板破例给他放了一个星期的假。
The boss made an exception and gave him a week off.
这种观念根深蒂固。
This idea is deeply rooted.
有些坏习惯根深蒂固，很难改。
Some bad habits are deep-rooted and hard to change.
歹徒抢了银行。
The criminals robbed the bank.
警察很快抓住了那个歹徒。
The police quickly caught the thug.
这是给你的奖赏。
This is your reward.
老板奖赏了工作努力的员工。
The boss rewarded the hardworking staff.
别拘束，就像在自己家一样。
Don't be shy; make yourself at home.
第一次见面，她有点拘束。
Meeting for the first time, she was a bit stiff.
他不知羞耻。
He has no sense of shame.
她感到很羞耻。
She felt deeply ashamed.
我在北京迷路了。
I got lost in Beijing.
小孩子迷路了，在路边哭。
The little child was lost and crying by the road.
他喉咙疼，吞咽困难。
His throat hurts and it's hard to swallow.
吃药的时候要多喝水，便于吞咽。
Drink plenty of water with pills so they go down easily.
这本书太深奥了。
This book is too deep.
他讲的道理很深奥，我听不懂。
What he explained was too profound for me to understand.
学语言不能急于求成。
You can't rush learning a language.
他太急于求成，反而做错了。
He was so eager for quick results that he got it wrong.

m: Can **not** **raise** your **look** to someone: **to look down on**.
ex: 别看不起穷人。
Don't look down on poor people.
他总是看不起别人。
He always looks down on others.
老师在黑板上写字。
The teacher writes on the blackboard.
请把黑板擦干净。
Please wipe the blackboard clean.

m: Cut the water to move a **boat**: **to row a boat**.
ex: 我们去湖上划船吧。
Let's go rowing on the lake.
周末很多人在公园划船。
At the weekend many people go boating in the park.
use: Split as 划了一会儿船.

m: **Carry** trouble and **push aside**: **to stir up trouble**.
ex: 别挑拨我们的关系。
Don't try to turn us against each other.
有人在中间挑拨，他们才吵起来。
Someone stirred things up, so they started arguing.
产品质量要严格把关。
Product quality must be checked strictly.
这件事由经理把关。
The manager is in charge of checking this.
这次比赛中国是东道主。
China is the host of this competition.
作为东道主，我们要好好招待客人。
As hosts, we should treat our guests well.

m: What is **provided** does **not** **answer** what is **sought**: **demand exceeds supply**.
ex: 这种手机供不应求。
This phone is in short supply.
节日期间，火车票供不应求。
During holidays, train tickets sell out.
他因为殴打别人被抓了。
He was arrested for beating someone up.
那个人在街上殴打司机。
That man attacked a driver in the street.
河水很混浊。
The river water is muddy.
房间里的空气很混浊。
The air in the room is stuffy.
谢谢你们的盛情款待。
Thank you for your generous hospitality.
主人的盛情让我很感动。
I was moved by the host's warm welcome.
use: Formal; often 盛情款待, 盛情邀请.

ex: 请问卫生间在哪儿？
Excuse me, where is the toilet?
这套房子有两个卫生间。
This flat has two bathrooms.
元宵节要吃汤圆。
At the Lantern Festival people eat sweet rice balls.
元宵节晚上，街上挂满了灯笼。
On the night of the Lantern Festival, the streets are hung with lanterns.
use: 15th day of the first lunar month.

m: **Reach** the **square**, the mark: **to pass** a test.
ex: 我考试及格了。
I passed the exam.
这次考试有五个人没及格。
Five people failed this exam.
认识您很荣幸。
It's an honour to meet you.
我很荣幸能参加这次会议。
I'm honoured to attend this meeting.
别泄气，下次会更好。
Don't lose heart; next time will be better.
失败了几次，他有点泄气了。
After failing a few times, he got a little discouraged.
这双鞋很耐用。
These shoes are very hard-wearing.
这种手机便宜又耐用。
This phone is cheap and durable.
她正在哺乳期。
She is in the breastfeeding period.
鲸鱼是哺乳动物。
Whales are mammals.
我不会亏待你的。
I won't treat you badly.
公司从来没有亏待过员工。
The company has never treated its staff unfairly.
他说话很风趣。
He talks in a witty way.
我们的老师很风趣，大家都喜欢上他的课。
Our teacher is funny, and everyone likes his classes.
她举止很文雅。
She has refined manners.
他说话文雅，很有礼貌。
He speaks in a cultivated, polite way.
她做事有条不紊。
She does things methodically.
工作虽然多，他还是安排得有条不紊。
Though there's a lot of work, he organizes it in an orderly way.

m: The **evening** that **gets rid of** the old year: **New Year's Eve**.
ex: 除夕晚上全家吃团圆饭。
On New Year's Eve the whole family has a reunion dinner.
今年除夕你在哪里过？
Where are you spending New Year's Eve this year?
他是我的工作搭档。
He's my work partner.
我们俩搭档了很多年。
We've been partners for many years.
他吃得津津有味。
He ate with great relish.
孩子们津津有味地听故事。
The children listened to the story with keen interest.
他经常酗酒。
He often drinks heavily.
酗酒对身体伤害很大。
Heavy drinking does great harm to your body.
这些小偷太猖狂了。
These thieves are too brazen.
最近诈骗电话很猖狂。
Scam calls are rampant lately.

m: **Cross** over to satisfy an **addiction**: **satisfying**, a real thrill.
ex: 这场比赛看得真过瘾！
This match was really thrilling to watch!
吃火锅真过瘾。
Hotpot really hits the spot.

m: **Words** set in **order** at the front: a **preface**.
ex: 这本书的序言写得很好。
The preface of this book is well written.
请朋友为我的书写一篇序言。
I asked a friend to write a preface for my book.
看完电影你有什么感想？
What did you think of the film?
请大家谈谈这次旅行的感想。
Please share your thoughts about this trip.
use: Goes with 谈 and 写.

ex: 他太懒惰了。
He's too lazy.
懒惰的人很难成功。
Lazy people rarely succeed.
他说话很有条理。
He speaks in a clear, organized way.
这篇文章缺乏条理。
This article lacks structure.
好久没弹钢琴，手有点生疏了。
I haven't played piano for ages; I'm a bit rusty.
我对这里的环境还很生疏。
I'm still unfamiliar with this place.
use: For skills you have lost and places you don't know.

ex: 他谢绝了我的帮助。
He politely declined my help.
本店谢绝吸烟。
Smoking is not permitted in this shop.
use: On signs: 谢绝参观, no visitors.

ex: 我去超市买些日用品。
I'm going to the supermarket for some everyday items.
牙膏、毛巾都是日用品。
Toothpaste and towels are daily necessities.
他知道很多内幕。
He knows a lot of the inside story.
记者调查了这件事的内幕。
The journalist investigated what was behind this affair.
use: Often 内幕消息, insider news.

m: The **colour** of your **air**: **complexion**, how one looks.
ex: 你今天气色不错。
You look well today.
他生病以后气色很差。
He's looked pale since he got ill.
use: Comment on how healthy someone looks.

m: **Leave** something to **remember**: **to keep as a souvenir**.
ex: 我们拍张照片留念吧。
Let's take a photo as a keepsake.
这本书送给你留念。
Keep this book to remember me by.
他一听就发火了。
He flew into a rage as soon as he heard.
别对孩子发火。
Don't lose your temper with the kids.
你不能总是迁就他。
You can't always give in to him.
父母太迁就孩子了。
The parents indulge the child too much.
学习和实践是相辅相成的。
Study and practice complement each other.
这两种方法相辅相成，效果很好。
The two methods work well together.
老师勉励我们努力学习。
The teacher encouraged us to study hard.
我们互相勉励，一起进步。
We encourage each other and improve together.
这个男孩太淘气了。
This boy is so naughty.
小狗很淘气，把鞋咬坏了。
The puppy was naughty and chewed up a shoe.
我妈妈每天晚上看连续剧。
My mum watches TV dramas every evening.
这部连续剧一共有四十集。
This series has forty episodes in total.
use: Measure word 部; episode is 集.

ex: 老师对我们很和蔼。
The teacher is very kind to us.
一位和蔼的老人给我指了路。
An amiable old man showed me the way.
use: For elders and teachers; 和蔼可亲.

ex: 不能让这种坏风气滋长。
We can't let this bad trend grow.
骄傲的情绪开始在他心里滋长。
Pride began to grow in his heart.
这样对待动物不人道。
Treating animals like this is inhumane.
他们向灾区提供了人道主义援助。
They provided humanitarian aid to the disaster area.
我爸爸去年戒烟了。
My dad quit smoking last year.
为了健康，你应该戒烟。
For your health, you should give up smoking.
use: Like 戒酒, to quit drinking.

ex: 你有空闲的时候来找我。
Come and see me when you're free.
他空闲时喜欢看书。
He likes reading in his spare time.
use: In speech 有空 is common.

ex: 他被公司解雇了。
He was fired by the company.
老板没有理由解雇她。
The boss has no reason to fire her.
孩子们喜欢看动画片。
Children love watching cartoons.
这部动画片很受欢迎。
This animated film is very popular.
这么热的天出去真受罪。
Going out in this heat is torture.
生病的孩子在医院受罪。
The sick child is suffering in hospital.

m: The **book** that **pierces through** your family line: **ancestral home**.
ex: 你的籍贯是哪里？
Where is your family originally from?
表格上要填写籍贯。
You need to fill in your place of origin on the form.
大树遮挡了阳光。
The big tree blocks the sunlight.
窗帘可以遮挡外面的视线。
Curtains keep out people's eyes from outside.
use: For blocking light, wind and view.

ex: 说话要有分寸。
You should speak with tact.
他做事很有分寸。
He knows where to draw the line.
use: 有分寸, tactful; 没分寸, tactless.

ex: 孩子们争先恐后地回答问题。
The children rushed to answer the questions.
大家争先恐后地上车。
Everyone pushed to get on the bus first.
她有点虚荣。
She's a bit vain.
别为了虚荣去借钱买名牌。
Don't borrow money for designer goods out of vanity.
这家公司压榨员工。
This company exploits its workers.
从甘蔗里压榨出糖汁。
Sugar juice is pressed out of sugar cane.
use: Also literally to press juice or oil.

ex: 他心眼儿很好。
He has a good heart.
这个人心眼儿小，别跟他开玩笑。
He's petty; don't joke with him.
use: 心眼儿小, petty; 心眼儿多, scheming.

ex: 给我一瓶矿泉水。
Give me a bottle of mineral water.
出门的时候带几瓶矿泉水。
Take a few bottles of water when you go out.
use: Measure word 瓶; the usual bottled water.

ex: 你不要贬低自己。
Don't put yourself down.
他总是贬低别人的工作。
He's always belittling others' work.
我有点近视。
I'm a bit short-sighted.
很多学生戴近视眼镜。
Many students wear glasses for short sight.
他的心里迸发出了希望。
Hope burst forth in his heart.
观众迸发出热烈的掌声。
The audience burst into warm applause.
这个成语是什么意思？
What does this idiom mean?
他说话喜欢用成语。
He likes using idioms when he talks.

m: The **east** seat, the master of the **house**: a **landlord**.
ex: 房东要涨房租了。
The landlord is going to raise the rent.
我的房东人很好。
My landlord is very nice.
这里可以省略一个字。
You can leave out a word here.
时间不够，我们省略了这一步。
There wasn't enough time, so we skipped this step.
他诽谤了我的名誉。
He slandered my reputation.
在网上诽谤别人是违法的。
Slandering others online is illegal.
爷爷见多识广。
Grandpa has seen and knows a lot.
他去过很多国家，见多识广。
He has been to many countries and is very worldly.
他是候选人之一。
He is one of the candidates.
这次有三位候选人。
There are three candidates this time.
拜托你帮我买瓶水。
Could you please buy me a bottle of water?
这件事就拜托你了。
I'm counting on you for this.
use: Polite; alone it can mean "Come on!"

ex: 他喜欢听摇滚音乐。
He likes listening to rock music.
这个摇滚乐队很有名。
This rock band is very famous.
我的伤口发炎了。
My wound is inflamed.
他喉咙发炎，说不出话来。
He has a throat infection and can't speak.
祝你一帆风顺！
Wishing you smooth sailing!
人生不可能一帆风顺。
Life can't always be plain sailing.
俯仰之间，一年过去了。
In the blink of an eye, a year has passed.
他这一生俯仰无愧。
He has lived his whole life with nothing to be ashamed of.
use: Literary; 俯仰之间 means in an instant.

ex: 你不能包庇他。
You can't cover for him.
有人包庇犯罪分子。
Someone harboured the criminals.
科技发展日新月异。
Technology is changing by the day.
这座城市日新月异。
This city changes with each passing day.
房价飙升。
House prices are soaring.
今天气温飙升到四十度。
Today the temperature shot up to forty degrees.
use: News language for prices and numbers.

m: A **temple** word for **that** instant: a **split second**.
ex: 在那一刹那，我明白了。
In that instant, I understood.
刹那间，天就黑了。
In a flash, it got dark.
他在门口东张西望。
He was looking all around at the door.
上课的时候别东张西望。
Don't look around in class.
use: Often a sign of nerves or not paying attention.

ex: 这条路凹凸不平。
This road is bumpy.
墙面凹凸不平，要重新刷。
The wall is uneven and needs repainting.
他对自己做的事很悔恨。
He deeply regrets what he did.
她流下了悔恨的眼泪。
She shed tears of remorse.

m: The **festival** at the **tip** of **noon** in the year: the **Dragon Boat Festival**.
ex: 端午节要吃粽子。
At the Dragon Boat Festival people eat zongzi.
端午节的时候，这里有龙舟比赛。
At the Dragon Boat Festival there are dragon boat races here.

m: Done like **grass** at a rough **rate**: **careless**, hasty.
ex: 这个决定太草率了。
This decision was too hasty.
这么重要的事，不能草率处理。
Such an important matter can't be handled carelessly.
我宁肯走路，也不坐他的车。
I'd rather walk than ride in his car.
他宁肯自己吃亏，也不让朋友吃亏。
He'd rather lose out himself than let a friend lose out.
use: Pattern: 宁肯A，也不B; same as 宁可.

m: **Worries** about what is **behind** you to **look after**: **worries back home**.
ex: 有了保险，就没有后顾之忧了。
With insurance, you have nothing to worry about back home.
公司帮员工解决了孩子上学的后顾之忧。
The company solved staff worries about their children's schooling.
请给我一张收据。
Please give me a receipt.
收据要保存好。
Keep your receipts safe.
过年的时候放烟花。
People set off fireworks at New Year.
天上的烟花真漂亮！
The fireworks in the sky are beautiful!

m: Going **around** and **breaking** off: **twists and turns**, trouble.
ex: 费了很多周折，才办好签证。
It took a lot of trouble to get the visa.
这件事几经周折，终于成功了。
After many twists and turns, it finally succeeded.
use: Often 费周折, 几经周折.

ex: 我们敬爱的老师退休了。
Our beloved teacher has retired.
他是一位受人敬爱的医生。
He is a well-loved and respected doctor.
借我一块橡皮。
Lend me an eraser.
写错了，用橡皮擦掉吧。
You wrote it wrong; rub it out with the eraser.
别灰心，再试一次。
Don't lose heart; try again.
考试失败后，他很灰心。
After failing the exam, he was very discouraged.
她戴着一对金耳环。
She is wearing a pair of gold earrings.
我的耳环丢了一只。
I've lost one of my earrings.
use: Measure word 对 for a pair, 只 for one.

ex: 学习要循序渐进。
Learning should go step by step.
锻炼身体也要循序渐进。
Exercise should also build up gradually.
你有空的话抽空来看看我。
If you're free, find time to come and see me.
他每天抽空学一个小时中文。
He finds an hour each day to study Chinese.
这个手镯是碧玉做的。
This bracelet is made of jasper.
湖水像碧玉一样绿。
The lake is as green as jade.
use: 小家碧玉: a pretty girl of a humble family.

ex: 前面有一座立交桥。
There's a flyover ahead.
北京有很多立交桥。
Beijing has many overpasses.
这里的人很好客。
People here are very hospitable.
他们一家都热情好客。
Their whole family is warm and hospitable.
妈妈为家里操劳了一辈子。
Mum worked hard for the family all her life.
别太操劳了，注意身体。
Don't overwork yourself; look after your health.
请饶恕我。
Please forgive me.
他犯的错不可饶恕。
The wrong he did is unforgivable.
墙上贴着一张布告。
A notice is posted on the wall.
学校发了布告，明天放假。
The school put up a notice: tomorrow is a holiday.
use: Measure word 张; 布告栏, notice board.

ex: 他工作兢兢业业。
He is very conscientious at work.
她兢兢业业地教了三十年书。
She taught diligently for thirty years.
孩子们喜欢卡通人物。
Children like cartoon characters.
这件衣服上有一个卡通小熊。
There's a cartoon bear on this shirt.
use: Often before nouns: 卡通片, 卡通人物.

ex: 他太吝啬了。
He's too stingy.
别那么吝啬，请大家喝杯咖啡吧。
Don't be so mean; buy everyone a coffee.

m: **Crawl** up a **mountain**: **to go hiking**, to climb a mountain.
ex: 周末我们去爬山。
We're going hiking at the weekend.
爬山是很好的运动。
Hill walking is good exercise.
别忘了备份文件。
Don't forget to back up your files.
我在电脑里有一份备份。
I have a backup on my computer.

m: **Again** take it on, **again** be **strict**: **keep up the good work**.
ex: 你们做得很好，要再接再厉！
You've done well; keep it up!
希望大家再接再厉，取得更好的成绩。
I hope everyone keeps pushing for even better results.
我每天下班去健身房。
I go to the gym every day after work.
这个健身房很大，人也很多。
This gym is big and busy.
use: 去健身房, to go to the gym.

ex: 新年联欢会很热闹。
The New Year party was very lively.
我们和外国留学生一起联欢。
We celebrated together with the foreign students.
use: 联欢会, a party or gala.

ex: 他工作一丝不苟。
He's meticulous in his work.
老师一丝不苟地批改作业。
The teacher marks homework with great care.

m: **Calmly** **living** and **happily** **working**: **to live in peace and work happily**.
ex: 老百姓希望安居乐业。
Ordinary people want to live and work in peace.
这里的人们安居乐业，生活很幸福。
People here live peacefully and happily.
这道菜太油腻了。
This dish is too greasy.
我不爱吃油腻的东西。
I don't like greasy food.
use: For food and also greasy hands.

ex: 现在是旅游淡季。
It's the off season for tourism.
淡季的机票便宜很多。
Plane tickets are much cheaper in the low season.
在大自然面前，人是渺小的。
In the face of nature, humans are tiny.
我觉得自己很渺小。
I feel very small.
这是一次举世瞩目的比赛。
This is a competition the whole world is watching.
中国的发展举世瞩目。
China's development has drawn worldwide attention.
这是一个好的预兆。
This is a good sign.
乌云是下雨的预兆。
Dark clouds are a sign of rain.
我喜欢了解各地的风土人情。
I like learning about local customs everywhere.
这本书介绍了南方的风土人情。
This book introduces the local life and customs of the south.
前面有个加油站。
There's a petrol station ahead.
车快没油了，我们去加油站吧。
We're nearly out of fuel; let's go to the petrol station.
use: Measure word 个 or 座.

m: **Suffer** a **calamity**: **to suffer**, to be in trouble.
ex: 大人吵架，孩子遭殃。
When adults fight, the children suffer.
一场大雨，地里的庄稼遭殃了。
A heavy rain ruined the crops in the fields.

m: Your **spirit** **goes out**: **to be lost in thought**.
ex: 他看着窗外出神。
He gazed out of the window, lost in thought.
她听音乐听得出神了。
She was spellbound by the music.

m: **Make** a **package**: **to pack**, to get a doggy bag.
ex: 服务员，请帮我打包。
Waiter, could you pack this up for me?
我把行李都打包好了。
I've packed all my luggage.
这是一家清真饭馆。
This is a halal restaurant.
附近有清真寺吗？
Is there a mosque nearby?
他们的婚姻很美满。
Their marriage is very happy.
祝你们家庭美满！
Wishing you a happy family life!
中国文化博大精深。
Chinese culture is broad and profound.
中医博大精深，值得研究。
Chinese medicine is profound and worth studying.

m: A paper to **execute** **according to** law: a **licence**.
ex: 他有驾驶执照。
He has a driving licence.
开饭店需要营业执照。
You need a business licence to open a restaurant.
use: Measure word 张 or 个.

ex: 洪水冲坏了堤坝。
The flood broke the dam.
人们在河边修建了堤坝。
People built dykes along the river.
这句话的标点用错了。
The punctuation in this sentence is wrong.
写作文要注意标点符号。
Pay attention to punctuation marks in essays.
孩子们无忧无虑地玩。
The children play without a care.
我很怀念小时候无忧无虑的生活。
I miss the carefree life of my childhood.
